title: In situ probe and inhibitory RNA synthesis using streamlined gene cloning
author: Wolff, Wagner, et al.
materials: Mix & Go! Competent Cells - DH5 Alpha
Zymo Research DNA Clean & Concentrator-5 kit

steps.title: Extract total RNA from planarians
steps.instruction: Isolate total RNA from pooled planarian samples using TRIzol, followed by phase separation, precipitation, washing, and resuspension.

substeps.instruction: Cool centrifuge to 4 °C before starting.
Place worms in a 2 mL tube and remove residual water.
Add 500 µL TRIzol reagent per 2–3 worms; freeze at –80 °C for ≥1 h.
Thaw lysate at 20–22 °C for 30 min–1 h, vortex every 10 min.
Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; transfer clear supernatant to a new tube.
Incubate supernatant 5 min at 20–22 °C to dissociate nucleoprotein complexes.
Add 200 µL chloroform per 1 mL TRIzol used; cap and vortex 1 min.
Incubate 3 min at 20–22 °C, then centrifuge 12,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 mL tube, avoiding interphase.
Add 500 µL isopropanol per 1 mL TRIzol used; mix 2 s and incubate 10 min at 20–22 °C.
Centrifuge 10 min at 12,000 × g at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Add 1 mL 75 % ethanol per 1 mL TRIzol used; vortex 2 s.
Centrifuge 5 min at 7,500 × g at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Air‑dry pellet 5–10 min (do not over‑dry).
Resuspend pellet in 20–50 µL nuclease‑free water; pipette up/down.
Incubate at 55–60 °C for 10–15 min in a heat block.
Quantify RNA using NanoDrop or Bioanalyzer; store at –80 °C or proceed to cDNA synthesis.

steps.title: Set up Gibson assembly reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare Gibson assembly mix containing digested pDL1 backbone and insert DNA at a 3:1 molar ratio, then incubate for assembly.

substeps.instruction: Calculate insert volume for a 3:1 molar ratio with 10–100 ng pDL1 backbone (2196 bp) using: insert µL = 3 × backbone µL × backbone ng / (insert ng/µL) × (insert bp / backbone bp).
We routinely use 2 µL vector diluted to 12.5 ng/µL (25 ng total).
Thaw on ice two 0.2 mL PCR tubes each containing 10 µL 2× Gibson Master Mix (one for experimental, one for control).
To each tube on ice add:
a) Calculated µL of pDL1 backbone,
b) Calculated µL of insert DNA (experimental) or equivalent µL nuclease‑free water (control),
c) Nuclease‑free water to bring volume to 10 µL total,
d) 0.5 µL BspQI (cuts at 50 °C, same site as SapI, creates asymmetrical cut).
Mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate the Gibson reaction at 50 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Transform competent cells with Gibson product
steps.instruction: Introduce the Gibson assembly mixture into competent E. coli cells, plate on selective media, and incubate for colony growth.

substeps.instruction: Warm LB‑Ampicillin (100 µg/mL ampicillin) agar plates to 37 °C; plates can be stored at 4 °C for up to 6 months.
Thaw two tubes of Mix & Go! competent cells on ice (or use equivalent DH5α competent cells).
Add 1 µL of the Gibson reaction (experimental or control) to each tube of competent cells; incubate on ice 5 min.
Plate the entire transformation mixture onto a pre‑warmed LB‑Ampicillin plate.
Incubate plates at 37 °C for 12–18 h.

steps.title: Grow cultures and miniprep plasmids
steps.instruction: Inoculate liquid LB‑Ampicillin cultures from single colonies, grow overnight, and purify plasmid DNA using a GeneJET miniprep kit.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 15 mL LB‑Ampicillin liquid media and divide equally into three 50 mL Falcon tubes (media can be stored at 20–22 °C for 3–4 months).
Pick a different single colony from the experimental plate and add to each tube.
Incubate tubes in a shaker at 37 °C, 400 rpm for 12–18 h (adjust rpm for shaker orbital diameter).
For each culture, use ~3.5 mL for miniprep following GeneJET kit instructions:
a) Transfer 1.5 mL culture to a 2 mL tube; centrifuge 10,000 × g, 30 s, 20–22 °C; discard supernatant.
b) Add remaining 2 mL culture to the same tube; centrifuge again; discard supernatant.
c) Add 250 µL Resuspension Solution; vortex until no clumps remain.
d) Add 250 µL Lysis Solution; invert 4–6 times until viscous and slightly clear.
e) Add 350 µL Neutralization Solution; invert 4–6 times; lysate becomes cloudy.
f) Centrifuge 12,000 × g, 5 min; transfer supernatant to GeneJET spin column.
g) Centrifuge column 12,000 × g, 1 min; discard flow‑through.
h) Add 500 µL Wash Solution; centrifuge 12,000 × g, 30–60 s; discard flow‑through.
i) Repeat wash with another 500 µL Wash Solution; centrifuge as above.
j) Centrifuge column an additional 1 min at 12,000 × g to remove residual ethanol.
k) Transfer column to a fresh 1.5 mL tube; add 50 µL Elution Buffer to membrane center; incubate 2 min at 20–22 °C.
l) Centrifuge 12,000 × g, 2 min to elute plasmid; discard column.
Quantify plasmid concentration; store purified plasmids at –20 °C.

steps.title: Verify plasmids by gel and sequencing
steps.instruction: Assess plasmid integrity by agarose gel electrophoresis and confirm insert sequence using M13 primers.

substeps.instruction: Load 1–3 µL of each purified plasmid and the original pDL1 vector on an agarose gel.
Identify successful Gibson clones by the brightest band that migrates less far than the pDL1 band.
If none of the three colonies are positive, pick additional colonies (unlikely due to high efficiency).
Sequence positive plasmids using M13 forward and reverse primers to confirm correct insert orientation and sequence.
